name: delegation_cascade
description: Exercises delegation chains and re-delegation. Note: token-votes delegation is not transitive for voting power — delegate() moves only the caller's own token balance to the new delegatee, so redelegating a downstream node does not carry upstream delegators' power with it. The on-chain delegation registry (contracts/token-votes/src/delegation_registry.rs) does track the resulting delegatee graph, though, and rejects delegate() calls that would close a cycle in it (independent of the power-transitivity point above) — this scenario also exercises that guard via the two ExpectError steps below.
